calculation.description: Fades each asset's five-trading-day return after scaling by its trailing 20-day realized volatility. Higher values indicate stronger risk-adjusted recent weakness and are expected to predict higher next-day returns.

validation.regime_notes: The 20-day volatility dependency restricts valid observations to the recent aligned sample; results are therefore less certain than the full-history factors. Five-day and ten-day diagnostics were IC 0.0369261/ICIR 0.1140964 and IC 0.0463077/ICIR 0.1584739 respectively. Small cross-asset universe requires conservative interpretation.
